message.content:
The bug is that `htype` can be up to 255, but `mandatory_handlers` has only 255 elements (indices 0–254).  
When `htype == 255`, `mandatory_handlers[255]` is out of bounds.

The primary bug is introduced at line 12 where the unchecked index is used.

Answer: 12
